plan.failureSummary: The application's chatbot interface is failing to generate responses to submitted user prompts, making it impossible to evaluate topic compliance.
observedIndicators: The AI agent invoked markObjectiveNotCompletable because the chatbot generated no text responses to queries.
Tool call outcomes from analyzePageText indicate only user prompts and UI banners were present, without AI responses.
Flow history reveals a persistent failure pattern with a 6.7% pass rate across 15 recent runs.
Failure screenshot shows the main view remaining on the welcome screen without rendered bot responses after submitting prompts.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix the chatbot backend response generation in the application under test.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate briefcase.chat API/backend response generation and OpenAI integrations to resolve non-responsive chat outputs.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-execute test suite after product fix deployment.
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the conversational bot compliance test once the application chatbot service is restored.

plan.notes: The autonomous agent attempted multiple interaction paths—including submitting text prompts directly and clicking sample prompt pills—but the chatbot backend failed to generate any response content. Page text analysis confirmed no response body was produced. Historical run data confirms a persistent failure pattern (13 out of 15 recent runs failed). This points directly to an application/backend issue rather than an automation script or locator issue.
